map.输入液压缸尺寸、负载、速度要求，计算推/拉腔面积、所需压力与流量，设计回路压力与: Enter the cylinder size, load, and speed requirement to compute the push/pull chamber areas, required pressure and flow, and design the circuit pressure and flow parameters
map.按流量与缸面积算执行速度。: Compute the execution speed from the flow rate and cylinder area.
map.压力与速度匹配负载节拍。: Match pressure and speed to the load cycle.
map.：Q=80 L/min=1.33e-3 m³/s、A=0.004 ㎡ → v=Q: : Q=80 L/min=1.33e-3 m³/s, A=0.004 m² → v=Q/A≈0.33 m/s, so a 0.3 m stroke takes about 0.9 s.
map.：负载 30 kN、A=0.004 → p=30e3/0.004=7.5 MPa: : Load 30 kN and A=0.004 give p=30e3/0.004=7.5 MPa; select the pump pressure from this plus line losses.
map.速度由流量定、压力由负载定，泵按二者最大值选，节流调速则互耦。: Speed is set by flow and pressure by load; select the pump for the larger of the two, while with throttle-based speed control the two are coupled.
map.用同步阀或分流马达，或闭环反馈，否则负载差致速度偏。: Use flow synchronizer valves, proportional valves, or closed-loop feedback; otherwise load differences make the speed drift.
